findings.title: Unguarded privileged writer: setOwner allows anyone to take ownership
findings.evidence_cypher: MATCH p = (e:Function {is_entry: true, guarded: false})-[:CALLS*1..6]->(t:Function {id: $id}) WITH p, length(p) AS len RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path ORDER BY len LIMIT 3
findings.explanation: Treasury.setOwner(address) is a public/external entry point with no access control that writes the privileged Treasury.owner state variable. Any attacker can call it directly to seize ownership of the Treasury.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an onlyOwner (or equivalent) access-control modifier to setOwner so only the current owner can change it.
